svg.title: Non-destructive display pipeline
svg.desc: Seven stages left to right: decode, trim, denoise, colour adjust, upscale, translate, present. The bracket explains that every stage produces an invalidatable derivative and the source image stays the only truth.

svg.text: PageSource keeps its shape: a page is still one image, only where that image comes from can be replaced.
